intro: Manic Monday: Kansas Cash demanded the market open, enlisted Grok for dividend ratings and a Kansas winter forecast, solved the economist lightbulb joke, and laid down a firm new rule about tinted windows. Full-spectrum Monday energy.

items.caption: Pure unfiltered market hunger. The man has places to be and trades to make. OPEN IT UP.
A new life rule just dropped, and it is non-negotiable. If he can't see you, you don't get the wave. Respect the code.
items.quote: I don't wave at people with tinted car windows.

items.caption: Someone asked how many economists it takes to change a lightbulb, and our guy came back with three, plus a gloriously specific stat about Novembers after midterms in even-numbered years. Quant comedy at its finest.
items.quote: 3, those two guys plus Ryan telling us that 87% of the time in November, after a midterm election, with a low number of hurricanes the previous season, in an even numbered year, the lightbulb change has been successful.

items.caption: Grok got the Oklahoma forecast, and Kansas Cash politely redirected it to the real question: what's winter going to look like in Kansas? Priorities, fam.
items.quote: forget about oklahoma, how will this make winter in kansas this year?

items.caption: Why read every reply to a dividend thread yourself when you can deputize Grok to rate them all against $SCHD? Delegation king.
items.quote: Hey @grok rate some of these suggestions in the comments against $SCHD
